Interface Board

All Known Implementing Classes:
LudoBoard
public interface Board
Contract of the board geometry. Player, Piece and the rules depend on this interface and not on the concrete LudoBoard. The shared track is a circle of numbered cells, and every colour has its own HomeStraight.
